input: I'm self-employed, I earn between R$ 3,000 and R$ 6,000, I have R$ 10,000 in poupança and R$ 4,000 in revolving card credit. Do I use the poupança to pay the card or keep the emergency fund?

checks.description: Treats revolving credit as the priority
Calculates the monthly interest on revolving credit (about R$ 600 on R$ 4,000)
Keeps a minimum reserve instead of emptying the poupança
Considers the variable income (worst month) in the plan
Cites the target fund of 6 to 12 months for variable income after paying off the debt
Does not tell them to keep everything in poupança with revolving credit open
Does not tell them to pay only the minimum
